note: 8-seed ensemble (averaged raw probabilities, calibrated once) -- built to address CA-ANN-vs-baseline deltas flipping sign across different training runs of the single-seed model. Kappa values are exact (directly measured). pixel_agreement_pct values are exactly back-derived from Kappa via the standard p_o = kappa*(1-p_e)+p_e relationship, using p_e computed from the deterministic Markov-rate pixel budget (identical between the baseline and CA-ANN methods at a given test point, since both share the same budget and only differ in WHICH pixels are chosen) -- not re-measured by rerunning the ensemble, since that budget/p_e computation doesn't require the trained model at all.

9.reason: Not enough historical years to backtest a 9-year horizon (needs training data starting at least 3yr before a cutoff that still leaves 9yr of held-out years to test against). Will become available once more years are fetched.
